text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, sounds good.
Let's live it up and make some noise.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And it could also serve as a good change of pace...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Did I just say... 'distraction'?
Even though I won, even though I took first place. Why...?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, sorry.
Let's save the celebration... for next time, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but it's only "postponed," ya hear?
I'll make up for it and party as hard
as I can some other time!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...So yeah. When that time comes,
I'm countin' on ya, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: All so they could greet the day when they could celebrate victory at full strength. And with that, I accepted Tamamo Cross's vow.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Right now, my head's completely filled with things that're already over
rather than the victory...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Why's it endin' up like this?
I gotta be way more aggressive...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
How can you be satisfied just with finishing the race...!
The races ahead are only gonna get tougher and fiercer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Was that anger directed at herself, or sadness?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her shoulders trembling in the waiting room, Tamamo Cross
channeled all of that energy toward her next race.
